label: sdc01_0190_system_01
text: You found the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Teal Mask[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: sdc01_0190_system_02
text: You put the Teal Mask in your Bag’s [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Key Items[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\npocket.

label: sdc01_0190_sister_01
text: Who was that? Where’d that kid come from...?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_select_01
text: I don’t think it’s a kid

label: sdc01_0190_select_02
text: Was it a Pokémon...?

label: sdc01_0190_sister_02
text: What’re you talking about? Wait, do you mean...?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_03
text: That kid we just saw... They ran off toward the\nmountain...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_04
text: C-could that have been the ogre?! From the story\non all the signboards?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_05
text: Are you saying that story was TRUE?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_06
text: I mean, they did drop a mask...so they really\nmust be...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_brother_02
text: What’re you guys doin’ over here?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0190_select_03
text: Oh, we just bumped into the ogre!

label: sdc01_0190_select_04
text: There was an ogre here, and—

label: sdc01_0190_sister_07
text: HEY! Wait—stop stop stop![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_brother_03
text: Wh-what? Why’re you yellin’ all of a sudden, Sis?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_08
text: It’s nothing! It’s nothing you’d be interested in at\nall, I swear![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_brother_05
text: Oh, I get it. I bet you were makin’ fun of me\nbehind my back...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0190_brother_06
text: I’m just...gonna head back to the festival...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_09
text: Whew. At least he didn’t figure out what we were\nreally talking about.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_10
text: Don’t scare me like that—blabbing for the whole\nworld to hear! Don’t you have any filter?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_11
text: See, Kiki really likes the ogre. Like, really, really,\nREALLY likes it.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_12
text: So, if he found out we’d seen the ogre without\nhim... I guess I was afraid he’d feel bad, y’know?\r\nFeel left out or something... Am I overthinking it?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_13
text: ’Sides, I didn’t want him running up the mountain\nto follow the ogre at this hour, either.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_14
text: Well...in any case, we already lied about it, and\nthat’s that.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_15
text: Let’s keep this whole thing our little secret, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_16
text: And maybe hold off on showing Kiki that mask\nyou just picked up, too.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_sister_17
text: Hee hee... The festival’s so much fun! And\nabsolutely NOTHING weird happened, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0190_stopper_01
text: You’d better not go up the mountain...
